notes.title: TRIBAL the 12 Gates Release Date
notes.notes:
It's official. TRIBAL the 12 Gates will release exclusively on STEAM Thursday April 14, 2022 at 12:01 AM.

A huge thanks and shoutout to all of our friends, supporters, and the STEAM community. 

Conquer. Be Conquered. Repeat.

notes.title: TRIBAL the 12 Gates Patch 1.0.84.3
notes.notes:
TRIBAL the 12 Gates
Patch 1.0.84.3

This patch contains incremental fixes and enhancements for TRIBAL the 12 Gates.

Platforms Effected:
TRIBAL Client for PC
TRIBAL Server for PC
TRIBAL Client for OSX
TRIBAL Server for OSX


Enhancements:
Added Friendly Target lines for Cast and Attack
Created Attack Priority System for Raid Parties, Dark Lords, and Bosses
Enchanters now wait for enemies to apply buffs
Healers now heal only when target threshold is below HP/MP to give

Bug Fixes:
Corrected teleporter behavior to spawn Evolved Bosses when teleporting everyone
Fixed bug that displayed enchant times incorrectly on Player Detail HUD
Fixed big that removed buffs prior to expiration time

notes.title: TRIBAL the 12 Gates Patch 1.0.81
notes.notes:
TRIBAL the 12 Gates 
Patch 1.0.81

This patch contains incremental fixes and enhancements for TRIBAL the 12 Gates.

Platforms Effected:

 TRIBAL Client for PC
 TRIBAL Server for PC
 TRIBAL Client for OSX
 TRIBAL Server for OSX


Enhancements:

 Increase starting resources to 20K (ease early game economy development)	
 Dark Lords now spawn within one minute on all maps (improves local server new game pace)
 Technology Tree now updates continually (allows viewing and live update of upgrades)


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed bug that caused regression of secondary stats during hp/mp regen to 1
 Fixed bug that prevented setting Build Priority to Wood/Food

notes.title: TRIBAL "The 12 Gates" Official Release
notes.notes:
Our team at tribal.games is proud to announce the general release date for Tribal “The Twelve Gates”, a single or multi-player persistent RTS.


Crazy how time moves like a freight train. We would like to extend a heart-felt “thanks” to the community testers that remained focused and dedicated from October of 2021 to current state. We couldn’t have done it without your feedback, support, and encouragement. 

Exclusively on STEAM Games!
April 14, 2022
